item.title: U.S. men's national team coach Mauricio Pochettino will stay through 2030 World Cup
item.description: Pochettino came on in 2024 to right the ship ahead of this year's World Cup, in which he led the team to a record three wins and helped ignite enthusiasm...

item.title: Washington wildfires destroy homes, force thousands to evacuate
item.description: Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown says nearly half of the city's neighborhoods have either been evacuated or are at risk as the fires remain uncontained.

item.title: Photos: Wildfires in Spokane trigger mass evacuations
item.description: Wildfires in Spokane have destroyed hundreds of homes and forced 60,000 people to evacuate.

item.title: Acting AG rescinds anti-weaponization fund; Trump calls off strike on Iran
item.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinds the anti-weaponization fund before his confirmation hearing. President Trump also calls off a strike on Iran.
